feat(auth): add app roles and three-level permission catalogs (#34)

* test(db): isolate integration databases

Keep Hawk DB suites off the shared aviary database so local
development data cannot change during tests.

* feat(auth): scope app permission catalogs

Keep platform, app-common, and app-private catalogs on the existing
permission tables so App roles cannot bind across domains.

* feat(sdk): regenerate management client

Expose generated App permission and role APIs so Robin can manage
scoped catalogs without hand-written client types.

* feat(robin): add app access control

Split platform vs App-common catalogs and add App workspace users,
roles, and permissions so operators can close the authorization loop.
